test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

After my first visit to Boston, I spent almost every winter in the North. Once l went on a visit to a New England village with its frozen lakes and __vast__ snow fields.
solution:
The correct answer is "**extensive.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Vast" means something of a very great extent or quantity**.

 
 
• Example: She has a vast knowledge of law.
 
 
 
• Synonym of "vast" is "extensive".
 
• **"Extensive" means covering a large area**.
 
 
• Example: The construction project required extensive planning and resources.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word " extensive" is the synonym of the word "vast."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1** (minimal)** means very small or insignificant.
 
• Option 2 **(shallow)** means not deep or superficial.
 
• Option 4 **(solid)** means firm or hard.
